brief.scope: Review the final git-refs monitor deliverable at this pinned ref, diff from origin/dev. Apply in/code-review-threshold.md and monitor-only-scope.md. Scope: literal branch/remote params, bounded shared local+remote deadline, strict OIDs/full refs, missing versus unavailable, state/source separation, existing conditions/queue/dedup, documented example. Tests are independently authored; verified red/green receipt is supplied. No onboarding, hooks, branch discovery/recovery, monitor lifecycle or activation. Report only reproducible/reachable in-scope failures with existing requirement, trigger, actual result and attempted refutation; separate unproven/expansion so suggestions do not become conditions. No source edits. Batch findings against this candidate; do not demand additional test inventory without a demonstrated missed failure. Audit security when job is security-audit, behavior/couplings when adversarial-review.

findings.claim: Requirement: monitor-lever.md Branch freshness says a missing or unreadable repo is unavailable, and a source unavailable during a valid run is data, not a config/state refusal; disabled entries are validated, never evaluated. Trigger: a valid v1 registry whose git-refs params.repo is a directory with a regular .git file that is not a gitdir: pointer (enabled true or false), isolated --state, WF_AGENT set, run --once. Actual: check exits 0; run exits 2 with `state: expected inspectable Git source storage for state separation; found unavailable Git storage path` and writes no observations, also blocking any sibling enabled adapter. Attempted refutation: unreadable Git metadata might have to refuse so state cannot overlap an unknown common dir. Rejected: a missing repo path and a dangling `gitdir: /missing` pointer both continue as unavailable readings, so this is not required for disjointness; inspecting a disabled git-refs source before observation also contradicts never-evaluated.

envelope.note: Not correction conditions: GIT_TRACE=1 makes local for-each-ref stderr trip reject_stderr and report local-unavailable on otherwise equal refs (env isolation is not a stated requirement). check accepts branches=[HEAD] but argv is refs/heads/HEAD, not abbreviated HEAD. Documented lever example checks valid; monitor.example.json is still the 3-monitor pin and activation is out of scope. Parent-walk of a non-git repo path can treat an ancestor .git directory as protected storage; deployment repo ../.. is a real checkout so that path is unverified here. Test file sha256 matches the supplied receipt; monitor.py sha256 matches the live-probe source stamp.
